scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:airport-catalog: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/airport-catalog.integration.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.airport-catalog.test.mjs && node scripts/.airport-catalog.test.mjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.airport-catalog.test.mjs; exit $status
scripts.test:queue-flow: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/queue-flow.integration.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.queue-flow.test.cjs && node scripts/.queue-flow.test.cjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.queue-flow.test.cjs; exit $status
scripts.test:seed-restoration: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/seed-restoration.integration.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.seed-restoration.test.cjs && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/.seed-restoration.test.cjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.seed-restoration.test.cjs; exit $status
scripts.test:concierge-guidance: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/concierge-guidance.integration.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.concierge-guidance.test.mjs && node scripts/.concierge-guidance.test.mjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.concierge-guidance.test.mjs; exit $status
scripts.test:manifest-flow: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/manifest-flow.integration.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.manifest-flow.test.cjs && node scripts/.manifest-flow.test.cjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.manifest-flow.test.cjs; exit $status
